name: applying-skill-best-practices
description: Best-practice standards for building Agent Skills on any platform: checking for an existing skill first, scoping it to one job, writing a description that triggers, keeping instructions lean, choosing model and effort settings, and preparing test cases from real examples. Use whenever a skill is being created, changed, reviewed or tested, alongside the platform's own skill creator: building one from scratch, turning a conversation or a repeated task into something reusable, updating or fixing an existing skill, or checking a SKILL.md before it's shared. Applies even if the user doesn't say "skill" or "best practices". Not for building agents, plugins, prompts or workflows that aren't skills, for running a skill that already works, or for auditing a set of existing skills (use auditing-agent-skills).
